title: 21-Year-Old Man Caught Fleeing the Scene While Intoxicated
description:
On May 23, 2021, police responded to a report of a hit and run shortly after 3 am in La Crosse, WI. It was discovered that a 21-year-old man crashed into a tree and fled the scene while intoxicated. 

News Report:
https://bit.ly/3CqfV1b

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

🛑 The featured content is NOT intended to be violent or glorify violence in any way. We are sharing the footage STRICTLY for the purposes of news reporting and educating. 🛑
